explication: Amethyst is a macOS tiling window manager. Users configure shortcuts or move the mouse; application and accessibility events enter the manager, which tracks applications, windows, screens, and Spaces. Screen managers select a configured layout, calculate frames, and schedule asynchronous window reflow through macOS accessibility APIs. Separate transition coordinators handle focus, swaps, movement, and navigation. Preferences persist layouts, shortcuts, floating rules, and behavior. The graph reflects sampled call sites and README capabilities; some AppDelegate wiring and unsampled layout implementations are represented only where their paths are explicit.
